reference: The new Mac mini with M6 (Apple), 43.02 s, 1920x1080, 23.976 fps, stereo 44.1 kHz
measuredBy: ffmpeg scene scores + signalstats + connected-component text boxes; eyes on 1 fps and key-frame sheets
genre: white-studio product comedy: one hero object receives an upgrade and transforms through four superpower vignettes, then a type lockup, logo, legal

stage.shadow: soft, from upper-left, long and diffuse
stage.table: seamless white studio sweep, horizon about y 620

structure.title: Empty studio
structure.subject: none, then a hand slides the box in from the left

structure.title: The chip
structure.subject: close on the top face; a hand lowers a chip labelled with the upgrade name onto it; a small lightning spark

structure.title: Arms
structure.subject: front-on; a cartoon muscular arm punches out of the side, then legs; the box does push-ups

structure.title: Flex
structure.subject: the box stands on legs and flexes both arms

structure.title: Wheels
structure.subject: the box on the table grows wheels; a small toy-like truck skids in on a track leaving dust

structure.title: Monster truck
structure.subject: the truck build-up: exhaust stacks, flames, a green roll bar; racing along tracks, dust

structure.title: Robot
structure.subject: a robot form: a pink brain-like head, two mechanical arms; then many tentacle arms holding a camera, keyboard, charts, a molecule; then a single walking robot
structure.camera: eye-level medium, wide for the tentacle spread

structure.title: Rocket
structure.subject: the box with a red-and-grey jetpack of boosters, blue flames

structure.title: Launch
structure.subject: five rapid cuts about 0.42 s apart: lift-off, through white cloud masses, cloud close-ups

structure.title: Back on the table
structure.subject: the plain box alone on white, small, centred

structure.title: Lockup
structure.subject: 'The Mighty' enters left, product name enters right, sub-line under it; the box stays centred

structure.title: Logo
structure.subject: type and box out; the logo alone centred

structure.title: Legal
structure.subject: black; one line of small legal text near the bottom

type.note: boxes measured at 1920x1080 from frames at 34.8 s (lockup), 36.6 s (logo), 40.0 s (legal); sizes are glyph-box heights, not font sizes

audio.note: RMS per ~0.27 s in analysis.json; music from 0.1 s at about -21 dB RMS, a dip at 1.2-1.3 s, then -18 to -20 dB through the vignettes; percussive hits align with the transformations and the five launch cuts; silence after the logo cut
audio.voice: none; music and sound effects only

perSecond: analysis.json: luminance 165-180 through the studio scenes, 137-150 during the rocket and cloud scenes, 16 on black; motion energy peaks 0.09-0.13 during the launch cuts (30-32 s), lowest during the held type cards

replicationTargets.structure: 14 segments, boundaries within 2 frames of the above; the five launch cuts at 0.42 s spacing
replicationTargets.type: lockup boxes within 4 px and 3% size; timing within 2 frames; logo and legal positions likewise, with a fictional mark and name of matching box widths
replicationTargets.light: ground luminance 165-180 in studio segments; a soft upper-left key and a long diffuse shadow under the object
replicationTargets.motion: one hero object throughout; each vignette adds parts to it rather than replacing it
replicationTargets.notMeasured: surface realism of the 3D characters and clouds
